# Total Pharmacy Supply

> > Total Pharmacy Supply is a wholesale pharmaceutical packaging and compounding supply distributor offering prescription vials, bottles, blister cards, capsules, and specialty packaging for pharmacies and compounders.

Total Pharmacy Supply (TPS) specializes in bulk pharmacy packaging solutions and compounding supplies under brands like TPS Essentials, Total Pump, and SealSafe. The site serves independent pharmacies, compounding facilities, and healthcare providers with comprehensive medication packaging and administration equipment.
